fixes.description: AC04 requires reference/photo lifecycle changes to be handled deterministically. The round-1 implementation resolved the latest face reference fresh on every call (handling reference supersession) but had no dependency resolving the person's CURRENT photo master version and never compared it against FaceReferenceSnapshot.SourcePhotoMasterVersion - the builder's own documentation explicitly called source-photo supersession out of scope, which the acceptor found conflicted with the approved AC's own wording. An acceptance probe modelled a person whose current photo is v2 while the latest face reference was derived from photo v1: the service returned Matched and recorded v1, with no defined reject/invalidate/re-enrol outcome.
fixes.fix: IFaceReferenceGateway gains GetCurrentPhotoMasterVersionAsync, wired in BioBio005Module to BIO-PHO-001's already-registered PhotoMasterService.GetLatestAsync. FaceVerificationService.CompareAsync now resolves the current photo master version and compares it against the resolved reference's own SourcePhotoMasterVersion BEFORE attempting extraction/comparison; a mismatch (or no current photo master at all) records the new FaceComparisonOutcome.ReferenceStale outcome instead of proceeding to a biometric comparison, and FaceAuthorizationPolicy.Decide denies it with reason 'reference_stale'. FaceVerificationEvidence gained a CurrentPhotoMasterVersion field (populated on every attempt) for full traceability.
fixes.regression_tests: tests/features/bio-bio-005/FaceVerificationPhotoLifecycleTests.cs - reproduces the exact acceptance scenario (photo v1 reference, current photo v2, expects ReferenceStale not Matched), an identity with no current photo master at all, that staleness is checked before extraction is ever attempted (even against a garbage/empty live sample), and that the ordinary happy path (current photo == source photo) is unaffected.

summary: Implements BIO-BIO-005 (face 1:1 verification between a live/current capture and the claimed person's approved reference), built directly on BIO-BIO-001's provider/matcher contracts and a direct ProjectReference to BIO-BIO-003 for its genuinely public, host-agnostic quality/liveness contracts only (never its internal, Scoped-registered FaceEnrolmentService/IFaceBiometricReferenceRepository, which stay unreachable via C# visibility regardless of the reference). AC01: FaceVerificationService.CompareAsync persists exactly one FaceVerificationEvidence (Score/ThresholdUsed/QualityFaceCount/QualityApproved/ProviderId/ProviderVersion/CurrentPhotoMasterVersion) per call via the internal IFaceVerificationEvidenceStore, regardless of outcome. AC02: IFaceVerificationThresholdPolicy.GetThreshold(tenantId) is the ONLY source of the comparison threshold - CompareAsync's own signature has no threshold parameter at all. AC03: FaceVerificationEvidence carries no allow/deny field; Domain/FaceAuthorizationPolicy.Decide is a separate, pure, static function that derives a FaceAuthorizationDecision FROM a piece of evidence - CompareAsync never computes or returns one. AC04 (after the round-2 fix): Domain/IFaceReferenceGateway now resolves BOTH the claimed identity's latest approved reference AND their current photo master version fresh on every call, via narrow adapters onto BIO-BIO-003's FaceEnrolmentService and BIO-PHO-001's PhotoMasterService; a reference whose SourcePhotoMasterVersion no longer matches the current photo master version is a defined, deterministic FaceComparisonOutcome.ReferenceStale outcome, checked and recorded before any biometric comparison is attempted - never a silent stale match. Also applies BIO-BIO-004-F01's lesson proactively: IFaceProvider.ExtractTemplateAsync's failures are caught broadly (not only ArgumentException) and recorded as FaceComparisonOutcome.AcquisitionFailed, except a genuine caller cancellation, which still propagates. Evidence store and service are internal, gated by an explicit InternalsVisibleTo seam.
